messages:
ravi: noticed spike in mTLS rejects for service mesh in eu-west after RBAC rollout at 02:45UTC. ingress logs show tls: bad certificate.
mei: did we change any KMS grants or key policies recently?
ops-oncall: CloudTrail shows PutKeyPolicy on alias/keystore-eu at 02:46UTC from infra-ci. diff looks like signer/rotator principal removed.
paul: that would cause cert-manager to fallback to self-signed certs -> downstream rejects.
security-bot: Alert KEYS_POLICY_CHANGE (ID KMS-4830) created and linked to INC-5012.
ops-oncall: mitigation: created a scoped create-grant for arn:aws:iam::111:role/cert-signer with Sign+Describe; restarted cert-manager. services recovered. change logged in INC-5012.
mei: follow-ups: add KMS preflight to RBAC rollout CI, add saved ES query for PutKeyPolicy events, and update runbook with emergency grant commands.
ravi: assigning postmortem to paul. include remediation owners and timeline. thanks all :+1:
